guides.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
guides.deck: Two machines that both say air fryer are often answering different questions. Here is the short list of things worth writing down before you decide.
guides.question_answered: Should I buy a basket air fryer or an oven-style countertop air fryer?

items.text: Measure the counter strip in centimetres, including the wall behind it
Measure the underside of the cabinet above that strip
Decide which way a door or basket handle can swing with the machine in place
Check whether the largest basket fits in the sink basin, not just the dishwasher

cta.label: See the single-basket listing we track

guides.next_step: Take the measurement sheet to the store or write it in the notes of the order, then open the gear page for whichever shape you chose.

guides.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
guides.deck: Quarts are the one number every listing leads with and the one most often quoted in a way that flatters the machine. Four checks turn a big number into a usable one.
guides.question_answered: How do I compare air fryer capacity between listings without being misled by the headline number?

items.text: Find the largest single thing you cook and ask whether it fits in one basket, not the total
If the capacity is a sum of baskets, divide it and check the halves against your portions
Assume you will cook in a single layer for anything you want crisp, and price the machine at that capacity
For oven-style, count usable rack positions rather than cavity quarts

guides.next_step: Write down your largest regular item and its rough size, then compare it to the basket dimensions on the listing rather than the quart figure.

guides.title: Cleanup and counter space: the trade-offs nobody puts in the headline
guides.deck: The machine you keep out is the machine you use. Both halves of that sentence are about dimensions and washing-up, not about cooking.
guides.question_answered: What are the cleanup and counter-space trade-offs between air fryer styles?

items.text: Does the basket fit flat in the sink, or does it float at an angle and stay greasy
Treat dishwasher-safe as a seller's claim and check the rack you actually have
Find out what the coating is before you buy a metal spatula for it
Decide now where it lives; a machine that lives in a cupboard gets used on Tuesdays
Leave the rear clearance the listing asks for, or the machine throttles and your counter yellows

cta.label: See the twin-basket listing we track

guides.next_step: Photograph your intended spot with a tape measure in frame; it settles more arguments than any spec sheet.

guides.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
guides.deck: Twenty-four presets is a claim about the control panel. Six questions get you to the parts that decide whether it replaces anything.
guides.question_answered: What should I ask before buying a multi-function countertop appliance?

items.text: Which appliance at home would genuinely leave, and which one will still be there in a year
What is the machine's worst function, and how often do you use it
Can you set time and temperature independently, or only pick a preset
Which accessories are in the box, and what does the missing one cost
Where do you send it when it fails, and who pays for shipping
Read the terms of any protection plan offer on the listing before treating it as a warranty

guides.title: Is a probe thermometer worth it for air-fryer and countertop-oven cooking?
guides.deck: A small appliance is a fast, uneven heat source. This is the case for buying the boring instrument that settles it, and the numbers that make it worth something.
guides.question_answered: Do I need a wireless probe thermometer for countertop cooking?

items.text: Know where the thickest part of what you cook actually is
Learn three numbers: 165 °F for poultry, 160 °F for ground meat, 145 °F plus a rest for whole cuts
Check which parts of the cable may sit in the heat path and which may not
Decide whether you want an app at all, because it is a thing you will also have to charge
Keep an instant-read thermometer for the things a probe cannot reach

cta.label: See the multi-probe listing we track

guides.next_step: If you cook for more than four people more than twice a month, the arithmetic favours the multi-probe; otherwise buy the simple one and put the difference in groceries.
